# v1.1.0 — Anchor-Locked EPUB Engine, Whole-Book Intelligence & Deep Deterministic QA

The **v1.1.0** release hardens **d-transcreate-skill** for production book-scale runs (300–600+ pages). This release resolves real-world failure modes in layout-preserving EPUB assembly, multi-page PDF ingestion, late-book entity recall, multi-worker context slicing, cross-book glossary hygiene, and deterministic QA enforcement—delivered with zero external Python dependencies.

---

## Key Highlights

- **Anchor-Locked EPUB DOM & Inline Asset Engine (`<!-- @bN -->`)**
  - `book_ops.py scan` embeds exact block anchors (`<!-- @b0 -->`, `<!-- @b1 -->`, …) per XHTML leaf element and preserves inline links/footnotes (`<a epub:type="noteref"><sup>1</sup></a>`) and mid-block images through lossless Markdown inline link/image round-tripping.
  - During `merge`, Anchor-Locked Layout-Preserving EPUB Mode pins every translated block back to its exact original XHTML container—eliminating downstream CSS class/heading drift when translators split dialogue into multiple `—` turns or merge prose paragraphs—while cloning split sibling `<p>`/`<li>` elements without duplicate `id=` attributes, protecting `<td>`/`<th>` table grids, and restoring original `<a>`/`<sup>`/`<img>` attributes byte-for-byte.
  - Anchor comments are stripped transparently from word/paragraph counters, `.txt`, `.md`, and `.epub` outputs.

- **Whole-Book Entity & Term Mining (`book_ops.py mine-terms`)**
  - Automatically runs inside `scan` (and standalone via `mine-terms`) across the entire `source_chunks/` corpus to extract recurring multi-word proper nouns, mid-sentence named entities, acronyms, CJK bracketed names (`《…》`, `「…」`), and italicized special terms into `candidate-terms.json` and `source-map.md`.
  - Ensures Phase 3 researchers catch critical characters, artifacts, and domain terminology introduced in middle or late chapters before Phase 5 translation begins.

- **Scoped Worker Packet Bundler (`book_ops.py bundle-chunk`)**
  - Assembles ready-to-dispatch per-chunk prompt packets (`packets/<chunk_id>-<role>.md`) containing the verbatim `WORKER CONTRACT CARD`, compact `Translation_Brief`, filtered `Research_Dossier`, chunk-matched `glossary.csv` + `glossary-inbox.jsonl` rows, filtered `Story_Bible` / `Domain_Map` entries, adjacent `Chunk_Summary` files, `Style_Sheet` (with the new **Golden Voice Calibration Sample**), and source/target chunks.

- **Sliding-Window Phase 6 Voice Pass (`output/<chunk_id>.md`)**
  - Replaces monolithic full-book output regeneration with a centralized Sliding-Window Voice & Seam Pass directly across consecutive `output/<chunk_id>.md` windows before `verify` and `merge`—eliminating single-prompt truncation on full-length novels while guaranteeing `.txt`, `.md`, and `.epub` outputs remain 100% identical in prose.

- **Smart PDF Running Chrome & Footnote Recovery**
  - Normalizes edge digits (`12 | CHAPTER 1` / `CHAPTER 1 | 13`) and scans sliding 6-page windows to strip alternating recto/verso and per-chapter running headers/footers without dropping genuine chapter openings.
  - Detaches page-bottom footnote blocks (`[1] ...`, superscript markers, horizontal rule notes) before cross-page paragraph reflow and re-attaches them cleanly to their owning chapter.

- **Domain-Safe Memory & 37-Column `d-research` v3.3 Ledger Bridge**
  - `init` and `sync-glossary` now support `--domain <all|fiction|technical|legal|general>` and `--filter-to-source` so fantasy lore terms (e.g., `Artifact -> Cổ vật`) never pollute technical manuals, plus `--approve-clean` for low-friction wave locking.
  - `--promote` automatically blocks story-specific entities (`proper-name`, `character`, `place`, `[no-promote]`) from leaking into shared `memory/glossary-<lang>.csv` unless `--include-proper-nouns` is explicitly passed.
  - Automatically initializes and bidirectionally syncs `evidence-ledger.jsonl` with the canonical 37-column `d-research` v3.3 `evidence-ledger.csv`.

- **Deep Deterministic QA (`book_ops.py verify`) & Authentic Vietnamese Profile**
  - Language-pair-calibrated word ratio thresholds (e.g., compact `vi -> en` vs `en -> vi`), `--require-dossier` completeness gate, `--enforce-glossary` and retroactive cross-chunk glossary drift warnings, URL/number formal-data parity (`formal-data`), untranslated CJK script-leakage detection (`script-leakage`), and Vietnamese dialogue/anti-translatorese linting (`locale-vi`).
  - Restored full, publication-grade accented Vietnamese orthography in `core/locales/vi-VN.md`, validated by new release check **C24** in `scripts/validate_pack.py`.

## CLI Reference (8 Subcommands)

```bash
# 1. Initialize workspace with domain-filtered Tier-1 glossary & dual ledgers
python3 scripts/book_ops.py init --source book.epub --target-lang vi --domain fiction --workspace ./book-ws

# 2. Scan book, emit anchor-locked chunks, convert PDFs, and mine whole-book terms
python3 scripts/book_ops.py scan --source book.epub --workspace ./book-ws --max-words 1500
python3 scripts/book_ops.py mine-terms --workspace ./book-ws --top 200 --min-freq 2

# 3. Sync domain-filtered glossary against scanned source & bridge d-research ledgers
python3 scripts/book_ops.py sync-glossary --workspace ./book-ws --seed --target-lang vi --domain fiction --filter-to-source

# 4. Build zero-overhead scoped worker packets for translators & reviewers
python3 scripts/book_ops.py bundle-chunk --workspace ./book-ws --chunk chunk-001 --role chunk-translator

# 5. Synchronize wave inbox terms with auto-approval of clean high/medium entries
python3 scripts/book_ops.py sync-glossary --workspace ./book-ws --approve-clean

# 6. Verify completeness, dossier, formal data, zero script leakage, locale & glossary
python3 scripts/book_ops.py verify --workspace ./book-ws --require-dossier --enforce-glossary --strict

# 7. Merge final deliverables (Anchor-Locked Layout-Preserving EPUB + clean TXT)
python3 scripts/book_ops.py merge --workspace ./book-ws --out book_vi.epub --format both --require-dossier

# 8. Promote vetted reusable terms to Tier-1 memory (proper nouns guarded)
python3 scripts/book_ops.py sync-glossary --workspace ./book-ws --promote --target-lang vi
```

## Installation & Upgrade

Install or upgrade cleanly into any supported runtime (`portable`, `antigravity`, `claude-code`, `codex`, `cursor`, `opencode`, `generic`):

```bash
# Example: Antigravity with bundled d-research module
python3 scripts/build_adapters.py \
  --platform antigravity \
  --dest ~/.gemini/config/skills/d-transcreate \
  --with-d-research ~/.gemini/config/skills/d-research-skill \
  --force
```

### Upgrading from `1.0.0`

- Re-run `scripts/build_adapters.py ... --force` to update `scripts/book_ops.py`, `scripts/validate_pack.py`, `core/`, `templates/`, and `memory/README.md`.
- Existing workspaces from `v1.0.0` remain backward compatible: unanchored translated chunks without `<!-- @bN -->` automatically use heading-partitioned fallback DOM alignment during `merge`, while `--require-dossier` and `--enforce-glossary` are opt-in flags on `verify`/`merge`.
